exposure: Intrathecal morphine and fentanyl with acetaminophen and NSAIDs
Intrathecal fentanyl with systemic acetaminophen and NSAIDs
outcome: Severity of postoperative pain (at rest and with movement)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 514 women undergoing elective caesarean section.
finding: The combination of intrathecal morphine and fentanyl with acetaminophen and NSAIDs was associated with better postoperative pain control compared to other analgesic strategies after elective caesarean section.
